title: DurableWorkspaceDescriptor
description: A product-scoped, durable, writable clone at an exact pinned commit. A SECOND type rather than a relaxed WorkspaceDescriptor: workerExecutionId, workerId and worktreePath are per-execution concepts a product's durable clone has none of, and making them nullable would push null-handling into the artifact-resolution chain that must fail closed. `kind` is a constant, non-optional discriminator because `onboarding_record.workspace` carries both shapes in one JSON column and nothing else tells them apart; a reader that cannot tell them apart would resolve a durable clone as if it belonged to a worker execution that never owned it. There is deliberately no `cleanedAt`: who deletes a product's only checkout is an open decision, and a field no writer produces is a capability a reader could believe in.
